note: This pointer stands in for the 5.6 MiB locator_sweep.json, which is bulk run data and is hosted in the public Quilt package rather than in git, matching the convention 009.02 established for sweep.json and 009.06 for ladder_sweep.json. Only locator_analysis.py needs it: run the fetch command above to place the real file at experiments/sfp_representation/009_locator_artifacts/locator_sweep.json before running 'locator_analysis.py --check'. Every other locator module's --check path is self-contained and needs nothing fetched. Regenerating it locally instead of fetching costs about 1650 s of GPU-free CPU time via 'locator_sweep.py'.
purpose: all 1344 locator runs: 1 declared block x 4 arms x 21 structural folds x 8 seeds, each cell carrying one Rung-1 chamber-localization run and one Rung-2 recomposition run

related_artifact.note: locator_analysis.py ALSO reads 009_ladder_artifacts/ladder_sweep.json, to pair the cross-turn 009.08-minus-009.06 comparison per (fold_name, seed). That file is likewise bulk run data behind its own pointer at 009_ladder_artifacts/ladder_sweep.json.pointer.json. When it is absent the comparison degrades to an unpaired one against the means pinned in locator_task.PRIOR_009_06, and the artifact records which of the two it did in cross_turn.paired.
related_artifact.why: a paired interval over identical cells is a strictly stronger statement than a difference of two means, and both turns ran the same 21 structural folds with the same 8 seeds on splits built by the same functions

run_digests.note: Digests of the per-run rows with the non-replayable wall-clock keys stripped, exactly as locator_sweep.py records them. Recomputing them from a fetched file is a cheaper integrity check than a full byte comparison of the 5.6 MiB artifact.

quilt_hash.note: The Quilt manifest hashes entries with its own chunked scheme, so this value is expected to differ from the plain-file 'sha256' above. It is not a mismatch. Use 'sha256' to verify a fetched file with shasum.
